title: The Lanes' lot, the puddle
logline: The bowling alley's lot in March with one puddle the size of a car, the sign in it upside down, mostly dark, the pup drinking from the edge. The Rain's puddle moved a block.

panels.composition: A bowling alley's empty lot with a wide puddle reflecting the mostly dark neon sign upside down, a small three-legged dog drinking at the puddle's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bowling alley's empty lot with a wide puddle reflecting a mostly dark neon sign upside down and a small three-legged dog drinking at the puddle's edge, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
